scope: Reviewed email-preferences and identity claims only; not full six-source consolidation.

rows.requirement: Record product, web settings, global and repository-local Git email with precedence and account association; preserve old commits separately. Verify effective intended identity without recording personal values or secrets in committed evidence.
rows.negative_test: Global read-back cannot pass when local override differs; current setting cannot prove historical scrubbing or authenticated authorship.

rows.requirement: Keep cloud privacy selection and push-block selection separate; behaviorally verify latest-commit author-email blocking only under approved disposable test scope. Use separate read-only full-history exposure assessment; no broader guarantee from this setting.
rows.negative_test: Clean most-recent author email cannot certify earlier commits or committer emails safe; enabled checkbox cannot pass native behavior.

rows.requirement: Separately observe configured backup, mailbox control, notification delivery and approved recovery behavior. Require a recovery plan preserving existing access; do not infer 2FA bypass or managed-user self-service.
rows.negative_test: Saved backup address alone cannot pass recovery readiness or prove delivery.

rows.requirement: Preserve prohibition on managed-user address changes alongside documented ability to unverify for personal-account reuse. Bind exact operation and IdP ownership; resolve independently before any write rather than treating general prohibition as erasing the exception.
rows.negative_test: Documented unverification cannot authorize primary-email replacement; IdP access cannot certify third-party app identity.

rows.requirement: Distinguish ordinary primary change from restricted-account recovery and preserve their different removal/verification orders. Require exact approved target, mailbox access, before/after evidence, ownership continuity and rollback limits; support acceptance remains external.
rows.negative_test: Ordinary removal-before-verification cannot certify safe restricted recovery; verified address cannot prove restriction lifted.

rows.requirement: Treat Desktop, Git name/email and personal remote strings as clues, reconcile to stable authorized account and current owner. Avoid organization/other-owner clones and renamed stale links as user identity proof.
rows.negative_test: Organization remote or configurable user.name cannot pass acting-user authentication.

limitations: Negative-test entries are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
No private account values, credential change, recovery operation or native activation.
Claim identity checks do not certify semantic equivalence, rights clearance or omission completeness.
